SELECT po.id AS "id", po.material_code AS "materialCode", po.material_name AS "materialName", po.qty AS "qty", po.order_date AS "orderDate", (SELECT cln.name FROM clients cln WHERE cln.client_code = po.client_code LIMIT 1) AS "clientName", po.client_code AS "clientCode", EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM material_receiving r WHERE r.po_id = po.id) AS "received" FROM material_purchase_order po
po.order_date = #{date}
AND po.order_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}
AND (SELECT cln.name FROM clients cln WHERE cln.client_code = po.client_code LIMIT 1) ILIKE '%' || #{clientQ} || '%'
AND po.material_name ILIKE '%' || #{materialQ} || '%'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM material_receiving r WHERE r.po_id = po.id)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM material_receiving r WHERE r.po_id = po.id)
ORDER BY po.order_date DESC, po.id DESC
SELECT name FROM materials WHERE code = #{code} AND use_yn = 'Y'

SELECT client_code FROM clients WHERE name = #{name} AND client_type IN ( SELECT i.item_code FROM tb_common_code_item i JOIN tb_common_code_group g ON g.common_code_group_id = i.group_id AND g.group_code = 'CUSTOMER_CATEGORY' JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND t.tenant_code = 'SONGYEON' WHERE i.item_nm LIKE '%매입%' ) AND COALESCE(use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y' AND client_code IS NOT NULL AND client_code != '' ORDER BY client_code LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM material_receiving WHERE po_id = #{id}
